abilities.desc_zh: 暴击率增益
abilities.desc_en: Crit Rate Buff

abilities.desc_zh: 功率消耗
abilities.desc_en: Power Burn

abilities.desc_zh: 传送费用
abilities.desc_en: Teleport Charges

abilities.desc_zh: 每 <s>12</s> {{var_1}} 获得一次传送费用（最大堆叠数：3）
abilities.desc_en: Gain a Teleport Charge every <s>12</s> {{var_1}} (Max Stacks: 3)

abilities.desc_zh: 当闹翻天受到暴击时，{{var_2}} 几率移除传送冲锋。相反，战士机器人有 {{var_3}} 机会。
abilities.desc_en: When Skywarp is hit by a Critical Hit, {{var_2}} chance to remove a Teleport Charge. Warrior bots have a {{var_3}} chance instead.

abilities.desc_zh: 如果闹翻天躲开了特殊技的攻击，闹翻天就会获得传送冲锋。每次特殊技限制 1 次传送费用。
abilities.desc_en: If Skywarp Dodges a hit from a Special Attack, Skywarp gains a Teleport Charge. Limit 1 Teleport Charge per Special Attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击有 {{var_4}} 几率导致 {{var_6}} 的 {{var_5}} 特殊技下降。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks have a {{var_4}} chance to cause {{var_5}} Special Attack Down for {{var_6}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 重型远程攻击有 {{var_7}} 几率导致 {{var_9}} 的 {{var_8}} 特殊技下降。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Ranged Attacks have a {{var_7}} chance to cause {{var_8}} Special Attack Down for {{var_9}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 传送攻击
abilities.desc_en: Teleport Attacks

abilities.desc_zh: 传送攻击有 +{{var_10}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: Teleport Attacks have +{{var_10}} Critical Chance.

abilities.desc_zh: 传送攻击无法阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: Teleport Attacks are Unblockable.

abilities.desc_zh: 传送攻击有 {{var_11}} 几率导致 {{var_12}} 电源锁定。
abilities.desc_en: Teleport Attacks have a {{var_11}} Chance to cause Power Lock for {{var_12}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 传送有 {{var_13}} 几率净化<s>燃烧</s>触电减益。
abilities.desc_en: Teleports have a {{var_13}} chance to Purify <s>Burn</s> Shock Debuffs.

abilities.title_zh: 闪避——闹翻天也可以利用他的传送进行防御，躲避危险。
abilities.title_en: Cut and Run - Skywarp can use his teleportation defensively too, dodging away from danger.
abilities.desc_zh:
受到攻击时：如果闹天有传送冲锋，{{var_14}} 几率闪避特殊技 1 或特殊技 2 的最后一击。这会消耗传送冲锋。

+{{var_15}} 每级
abilities.desc_en:
Cut and Run - Skywarp can use his teleportation defensively too, dodging away from danger.
When Attacked: If Skywarp has a Teleport Charge, {{var_14}} chance to dodge the last hit of a Special Attack 1 or Special Attack 2. This expends a Teleport Charge.
+{{var_15}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 闹翻天总是有他的妙计。
abilities.desc_en: Deceitful Hit - Skywarp always has a trick up his sleeve.

abilities.desc_zh: 如果闹翻天有传送冲锋，这就是传送攻击。
abilities.desc_en: If Skywarp has a Teleport Charge, this is a Teleport Attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击会导致 {{var_17}} 的 {{var_16}} 功率消耗。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks cause {{var_16}} Power Burn for {{var_17}}.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} 伤害和 {{var_26}}~{{var_27}} 所有霸天虎远程攻击的穿甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} Damage and {{var_26}}~{{var_27}} Armor Piercing for all Decepticon Ranged Attacks.
+{{var_28}}~{{var_29}} Special Attack Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_30}}~{{var_31}} 增加对拆除机器人的攻击评级。仅当团队中的所有机器人都具有此协同羁绊时，冲击波才能受益于此奖励
abilities.desc_en: {{var_30}}~{{var_31}} increase to Attack Rating against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only benefits from this bonus if all Bots on the team have this Synergy

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} 战斗开始时对{{var_34}}进行远程回避。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} Ranged evade for {{var_34}} at the start of combat.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为领导的灯塔，所有较低级别的队友都获得+{{var_35}}功率率。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +{{var_35}} Power Rate.
